label: Cultural Revolution, 1966-1976
editorialNote: Extracted from heading "China--History--Cultural Revolution, 1966-1976". Added to LCSH in 1986, revised in 1998. The list of sources for this entry indicates some disagreement about the dates of the Cultural Revolution proper, the first phase of which ended in 1969, but which is now considered to have continued until 1976 and the arrest of the Gang of Four.
